description:
Rent Includes storage locker 

There is no parking space available 

Swiss Cottage by havitat presents a brand new high-class development comprising 110 apartments, and lifestyle enhancing amenities, for a new way of renting. 

Swiss Cottage is located in the heart of Santry - an amenity rich neighbourhood surrounded by acres of green parkland where your everyday needs are within easy walking distance - great shops and restaurants, sports and leisure facilities, parks, and schools. Santry combines neighbourhood living with the convenience of excellent travel links into the city centre and is only minutes from major employment hubs such as Northwood, Beaumont Hospital, Dublin Airport and convenient to the Port Tunnel, M1 and M50.

Apartments at Swiss Cottage are designed to the highest standard. They offer open plan living /dining areas, large bedrooms, and balconies - many with unobstructed views across Dublin City and Bay. The apartments are contemporary in style and furnished to a luxury level. The dedicated lifestyle amenities at Swiss Cottage really set it apart and showcase how the development facilitates modern living. 

Apartment Perks:
Fully Furnished (contemporary style)
Modern Appliances
Integrated Kitchen 
Smart Energy Meter 
Landlord provided High Speed Internet in apartments (100MB)* 
Onsite Repairs
Landlord Provided TV Package*
Pet Friendly* 
A2/A3 BER rating
Majority with balcony/winter garden

Building Perks* 
Stylish business centre/lounge with dedicated work pods
Multipurpose bookable amenity room with kitchen 
Private media room / Cinema room 
Roof terrace area with seating, exclusively for residents’ use 
Residents’ lounge
Parcel delivery facility 
Coffee dock
Fully equipped state of the art Gym
Free Wi-Fi throughout the amenity spaces 
Landscaped courtyard
Bicycle storage
Community events 
Club Car exclusively for residents’ use **
Secure storage lockers (subject to separate charge)
CCTV
Online residents’ portal 
Recycling facilities
Secure access control 
Environmental waste disposal

The dedicated team appointed by havitat for Swiss Cottage is on hand to assist with any queries you may have to ensure everything runs smoothly in your new home. We look forward to welcoming you for a viewing. 

* Subject to availability at landlord discretion - terms, and conditions apply

** Subject to hourly rental fee payable directly to the Club Car Provider

*** Please note photos may not be specific to this apartment but all apartments are finished to similar standard 

**** Please note apartment size is based on the average size, the size of actual apartments may differ.
